narrative: On the almanack. The penny almanac open on the sill at Henley Street, a black circle printed beside the thirtieth of March. The pocket tables stay shut beside it. No quill is out. On the almanack. The almanac closed under the shut tables. The yard is darkening. He has written nothing on the day.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at the March leaf and left the tables shut.

entities.name: the penny almanac
entities.context: Shown on almanac in New moon in Lent
